approved: Superannuation (Excess Untaxed Roll-over Amounts Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

Moved the Superannuation (Excess Untaxed Roll-Over Amounts Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the tax rate on excess untaxed roll-over amounts rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014 to reflect the Medicare levy increase.

Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
Superannuation (Excess Untaxed Roll-over Amounts Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Act 2013
